text: Graph hygiene report flags only real defects; unknown idea ids answer 'not found'
description: Felix 2026-10-15: why do finished and cancelled parents show up in the report? Collapse candidates listed every parent whose children were all done, including already-implemented and cancelled ones (80, of which only 5 were actionable). Now only open/in-progress/partially parents count. The 'staleStatus' section is now 'unarchivedCancelledOrFailed' and no longer includes human-dependent (waiting, not settled). Also found in MCP use: reading an unknown idea id ran a forced migration of the whole project and failed with a misleading archived-ideas ENOENT; it now migrates only when the id exists in the legacy aims/ layout and otherwise throws 'Idea <id> not found'.

status.comment: New server tests: hygiene sections by parent status, legacy file returning through git still readable, unknown id names 'not found'. pnpm check 25/25. MCP needs /mcp reconnect to load it (the running MCP server predates today's fixes).
